Package index

Coordinate systems

Place one or more genomic windows, or the whole genome, on a single x-axis so tracks and junctions can be drawn across loci.

coord_locus()
Cartesian coordinates zoomed to a genomic locus
coord_loci()
Cartesian coordinates across multiple genomic loci
coord_genome()
Cartesian coordinates across the whole genome

Stacking tracks

Combine track plots that share genomic coordinates into one figure, and highlight regions across all tracks.

stack_tracks()
Stack tracks over shared genomic windows
highlight_stack()
Highlight sub-regions across a stack of tracks

Ideograms

Chromosome ideograms with cytobands, marking the windows shown in a plot.

Chromosome ideogram

Ideogram of a locus' chromosome with zoom trace

Highlight a window on an ideogram
annotate_ideogram_zoom()

theme_ideogram()
Theme for ideogram plots

scale_fill_giemsa()
